difficulty_reason: Even with the reconstruction core supplied, the authored proof must construct the abstract integration plus polynomial correction and remainder, then control compatibility of re-expansions across regularity and integrability levels. It uses distinct high-level and low-level decompositions of the same coefficient on opposite sides of t=|h|^ell, matching weighted model norms and singular integral exponents. At the full-gain endpoint beta=barbeta the nonresonance hypothesis permits a higher Taylor cutoff without changing its polynomial set, eliminating a logarithmic endpoint loss. These residual multilevel construction and endpoint mechanisms remain above ordinary qualification analysis and are distinct from the two-limit reconstruction of Theorem4.1; the Lipschitz comparison extension is outside the selected fixed claim.
